headline: COL @ LAA matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is COL 4.05 at LAA 6.20, with a projected total of 10.25. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward LAA: COL moved -0.28 runs while LAA moved +0.95, changing the projected margin by -1.22 runs. The projected total climbed +0.67, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -14.9%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: José Soriano has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 3.4 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Troy Johnston, Nolan Schanuel, Ezequiel Tovar, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Edouard Julien, Braxton Fulford because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
